tomorrow: Overnight toward Crete — Chania late on the 25th.

postcard.title: Made the connection
postcard.note: Burbank ran an hour late. We had an hour and a half to make the SFO flight and we used all of it. Through the terminal at a run, on the jetway with no time to spare. Seats found. Next stop, Greece.
